TEXT:
[FI] ...There has always been someone by my side, 
watching over me.

[FI] In the middle of my hectic life, no matter how 
many seasons passed, she was always there for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] It's all thanks to you, Manami-san. Everything, 
everything...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Kanako-chan, you really, really tried your best, 
didn't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I know that better than anyone else, without a 
doubt.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] You are my... life's worth of pride.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Just one thing, if that's alright...

[FI] Manami's face went red and she looked 
embarrassed.

[FI] Before long, she gathered her determination and 
stared directly into my eyes.

[FI] It was something that is unsuitable for this occasion, 
a confession.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for answering me properly.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] You've grown enough so you can answer honestly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] You said you weren't a softhearted person! You 
said you were plotting against me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] Not to hold back... not to lower my guard...
[FI] Her way of speaking returned to that of before.
[FI] Manami placed a gentle hand on Kanako's head.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I said it before, didn't I?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] When you let your guard down, I'll make you cry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: [FI] You didn't mean like this! You, idiot...!

[FI] Kanako buried her face in Manami's chest and 
sobbed.
